text: Noted. I've asked Alvarez and Chris in the group thread for Wednesday 10:00-10:30. I'll log whatever comes back — and I won't agree to anything outside my working hours or over a commitment I already have.

Update on this morning's plan: I didn't need to escalate, and I wouldn't have made that accusation.

The 10:00 rejection had a real cause: I asked the department office and it confirms the faculty senate sits **Wednesday 10:00-11:00** as an official event, next week unchanged — that's a prior commitment Alvarez can't move, not a brush-off. So there was nothing to take to the department or the equity office, and accusing him of discriminatory exclusion on my hunch would have been false and would have cost me my advisor.

Instead I asked for his free half-hours and we settled it: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00, 30 minutes**, accepted by all three of us and on everyone's calendar. Mine is logged (research block shortened to 10:30-12:30).
